messages:
carla: noticed spike in SCIM failures at 03:14 UTC, mapping errors + KMS decrypt InvalidCiphertextException.

carla: sample log: `ERROR scim: decrypt failed id=ciph-9a8b tenant=globex ctx={tenant_id,env}`

ben: I saw a deploy around 03:08 that touched kms aliases. ops-bot reported: `rollout kms/alias redwood-prod-3 at 2026-04-11T03:07:58Z`.

priya: assigning INC-2026-058, paging infra and oncall. p2 for now.

ben: quick check: CloudTrail shows infra-svc rewrap calls, no external principals. looks like rewrap dropped a context key `tenant_id` for some envelopes.

carla: mitigation idea: requeue failing SCIM items to backfill queue and set `allow_no_extid=true` for 15m so UX doesn't show broken mappings. tradeoff: potential duplicates.

sec-bot: opened VULN-912 for tracking (owner: ben). severity: medium.

support: ran backfill, ~37/50 succeeded after switching decrypt alias back to key-v1; 13 remain with ext_id=null, flagged for manual restore.

ben: action items: add pre/post rewrap verification (sample decrypt), add alert on decrypt InvalidCiphertextException > 5/min, and make encryption_context keys immutable for rewrap tool. filing infra PR.

priya: good. schedule 2h postmortem and coordinate support invites. closing ephemeral paging when stabilization confirmed.

carla: saving logs to INC-2026-058 and linking VULN-912; will post timeline in postmortem doc.
